provider_rules: Use only the MX records provided for lundusdigital.com in the LD Zoho Admin Console
Do not copy generic Zoho MX examples if the Admin Console shows a different data-center value
Maintain only one SPF TXT policy for the domain and merge authorized senders into that policy rather than publishing multiple SPF records
DKIM selector and public-key TXT value must come from the LD Zoho Admin Console
DMARC remains deferred until SPF and DKIM alignment are verified
pre_apply_checks: existing DNS records exported or captured for rollback
exact host/type/value/priority copied from Zoho Admin Console
no website A/CNAME record is modified as part of email-only change
post_apply_checks: outbound message from hello@lundusdigital.com received externally
pass_condition: All exact provider records are evidence-backed, approved, applied, propagated and verified; mailbox/alias send-receive tests pass.
